title: Authoritative Accepted Full-Interval Mass Accounting

canonical_mass_type.finding: Existing type already represents aggregate full-interval storage and external-flow totals, but lacks explicit storage_change, compact missing-contribution diagnostics, interval/provenance fields, and accepted-transaction provenance.

canonical_result_flow.finding: run_canonical_interval accumulates transaction diagnostics and commits only a completed private working state, but on full [t0,t1] completion explicitly forces result%mass%complete=.false. and does not aggregate accepted storage/flux terms.

transaction_flow.storage: model%storage(state) returns one scalar persistent physical storage value
transaction_flow.finding: Only the final accepted two-half branch should feed authoritative accounting; rejected full/half trials and retry attempts are already rolled back but their accepted mass terms are not exposed in transaction_result_t.

mass_seam.storage: volact + pond + optional crop interception storage

kernel_boundary.finding: kernel_result_t maps canonical_result_t%mass unchanged. Candidate provenance already carries lineage, revision and [t0,t1], but mass accounting is not bound to that provenance and commit_candidate does not expose accepted mass accounting.

serialized_backend.finding: For the admitted F-MR04 profile the physical bridge already calculates the required aggregate storage and external flux totals; the upstream contract cannot currently mark or transport them as authoritative complete accepted interval accounting.

root_cause: The authoritative accepted mass terms are computed locally during accepted transaction execution but are discarded before transaction_result/canonical_result/kernel_result publication; canonical runtime therefore intentionally leaves mass.complete=false.
